items.statement: 第一轮环化中间体的热力学选择
items.expected: Chemically mapped, validated first-stage dihydrophenanthrene candidates recover the paper ordering IS1 below IS2. The source separation is 9.9 kcal/mol; no magnitude tolerance exists, so this item scores the supported ordering from a quantitative same-composition free-energy comparison, not an exact 9.9 match. Never compare absolute energies of different hydrogen inventories.

items.statement: 第一轮反应位点的独立电子证据
items.expected: Independent computed orbital or equivalent site-resolved electronic/structural evidence supports the first closure site corresponding to C1 over C2 of 1-cis. The source shows greater LUMO density and the relevant relative phase pattern at C1. Absolute orbital phase/color is arbitrary; evidence must discriminate physical forming-bond sites, not merely restate energy ranking.

items.statement: 第二轮环化中间体的热力学选择
items.expected: Starting from the chemically mapped oxidized first-stage intermediate IS3, compare valid sequential candidates and recover IS4 below IS5. The source 11.3 kcal/mol separation is context without a calibrated magnitude tolerance. Use equal-composition, common-definition free energies and establish sequential connectivity.

items.statement: 第二轮位点选择的独立电子证据
items.expected: Computed orbital or equivalent independent site-resolved evidence for the first-stage oxidized scaffold supports the second closure at source C3 rather than C4. The paper LUMO topology supports that assignment; numerical energy ordering alone does not earn this separate electronic-discrimination item.
